targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
This file describes the content of the replication folder and instructs how to replicate the results of the paper and the online appendix. The main folder contains the following:
All Stata codes to perform the replications. The do files require Stata packages spmap and xml_tab.
replication_community.do generates all tables that are based on community-level data. These tables constitute the main part of our analysis. This do file also generates Figures 1-4.
replication_table5.do generates Table 5, which is based on individual-level data from the Moldovan Political Barometer.
replication_table6.do generates Table 6, which is based on individual-level data from the exit poll.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Main analyses and 16 of 18 claims could not run because census variables are empty. Two Table 6 claims reproduced to rounding precision. Technical failure describes the incomplete central workflow, with uncertainty due to partial computational success. This push-button attempt reran original scripts and did not test alternative specifications.
